scope: Diagnostic-only original PLY-3 Split/Extract, full public-MCP artifact download, GUI reopen and history on the integration build; forced Chrome page garbage collection immediately after artifact deletion
diagnostic: Compared Chrome DevTools page heap immediately before and after explicitly requesting collection. This is not normal application behavior or a controlled proof of causation.
result: Full download, GUI reopen, geometry and GUI undo/redo completed with no page or console errors. The guarded run failed because its reported peak exceeded 4 GiB, despite forced collection; no claim is made about which allocation caused the peak.
downloadCleanup: Driver deleted the temporary download after independently matching its hash.
limitations: The measured page heap excludes other Chrome processes and GPU memory. One forced-GC run cannot rule out retained allocations elsewhere or establish a repeatable resource fix. The standard no-forced-GC gate and complete M2 remain open.
